question: Complete the statement: Sodium hydrogen carbonate is used ________.

options.text: as a cleaning agent for domestic purposes
for removing permanent hardness of water

solution:
The correct answer is __**in soda-acid fire extinguishers.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Soda-acid fire extinguishers comprise **Sodium hydrogen carbonate** and sulphuric acid.
 
• It consists of a strong iron vessel with a side discharge nozzle.
 
• The iron vessel is filled with a sodium bicarbonate solution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Working principle of any fire extinguisher:

 
• ​Cooling of the combustible material below its ignition temperature.
 
• Cutting off the air supply.
 
• Cooling the combustible material simultaneously while cutting off the air supply.
